root_cause_of_the_dead_stop.summary: The Arena stalled because the target was invisible and the measurements were constitutionally muted.
evidence: The four approved mockups were never committed. Absent from origin/main, from every branch, and from cursor-arenafront, cursor-arena and cursor-arena-r2. Verified by enumeration, not by failing to find them.
arena_mockup_spec.md was archived into docs/archive/pre-constitution-reset-2026-07-20/. Section 10 makes archived files historical evidence that cannot define design or acceptance.

The archived copy carries a 2026-07-20 banner saying the 56-degree perspective is dead and must not be implemented. AGENTS.md section 11 at v1.3.0, dated 2026-07-23, re-permits it explicitly. Anyone who found the spec read the banner and stopped.

Consequence: colour was the only iterable dimension. About 127 releases, v2.5.462 to v2.5.589, cycled the same atmosphere slices (gold dust, ceiling vignette, side washes, floor dark, gold rails, stand haze, corner vignettes) while every structural gap stayed open.

measured_gap_ranked: 1. No perspective. Plan view versus a 56-degree tilt. One transform over the whole scene, geometry contract unchanged.
2. Inverted proportions. Floor should be 0.63 of frame width; stands 1.6 R_floor deep. Production has the floor filling the canvas and the stands as a rim.
3. Faces cropped by the seat polygon instead of fitted round portraits.
4. No depth falloff across the stands.
5. No gold rim lights at the floor and stands boundary.
6. No slate band between floor and stands.
7. HUD scattered on the page instead of framing the arena.

hard_rules_not_to_relearn: The arena floor is LIGHT warm parchment. There is no dark floor theme. Dark lives in the hall and stands.
There is no hero on the arena page. Permanent Owner decision.
The Arena is staff and superuser only until the Owner releases it. A 404 for everyone else is intended.
The rank label column is a legend and is deliberately the mirror of ring order. Do not 'fix' it.
Reuse first. Search, trace callers, find the source of truth, then reuse. New code only when absence is proven.
No demo battles. No synthetic interactive spectators. The 544 interactive seats are real viewers only.
